# alpinejs

Alpine.js (free, ~15kb) — lightweight reactive JS for dropdowns, tabs, modals, accordions on static/HTML sites, no build step needed. Include with:

```html
<script src="../../assets/vendor/alpinejs/alpine.min.js" defer></script>
```

Then use directly in markup, e.g. `<div x-data="{ open: false }"><button @click="open = !open">Toggle</button><div x-show="open">...</div></div>`.
